test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'INBOX’ is written as 'MRYCL' and 'EMAIL' is written as 'NVZOR'. How will 'DRAFT' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

1) 'INBOX’ is written as 'MRYCL'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12bfc11deaea742052f82ae7302551264dbf89288fb6a5cb5aa16e41e3ccb032.png] 

And,

2) 'EMAIL' is written as 'NVZOR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e8dc7bb6ff47d74b637fde61a0da83a8da6e93ccee7694bc3d2ab09a5e6cd80.png] 

Similarly,

3) 'DRAFT' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80d22a75ed5463a20b8c70a9490398888a476c939e34178e8c1679ab0b82992e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"IWZGU".**
